value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "Title: Comparing the Pedagogical Strategies of Teachers Who Co-Designed Units to Support Students’ Theory Building Abstract: Co-design is a collaborative approach intertwining individuals' unique perspectives resulting in a product that holds creative stakes for all parties."
